profile.headline: Software Development | .NET Solutions | Team Leadership & Mentoring
profile.geoLocationName: San Tan Valley, Arizona, United States
profile.summary:
As an innovative Software Developer, I offer 15+ years of diverse experience in the technology solutions space. During my career, I have consistently collaborated across business units, including with technical and nontechnical teams, to identify, implement, and troubleshoot technology and manage the SDLC. 

My ability to oversee end-to-end design, evaluate risks, resolve bugs, and deliver on customer success makes me an asset to any team. In particular, because I have worked in varied environments – from large-scale Fortune 500 companies through small businesses and startups – I can align our technology strategy with each organization’s needs. 

I am passionate about utilizing .NET to create scalable, innovative, and sustainable web applications, which I am confident will help any company reach their current and future goals. In addition, as a leader, I am comfortable mentoring junior engineers, sourcing new technology solutions, and advocating for software development teams. I add value to my companies because I can adapt quickly to the changing needs of business, clients, and markets, and I am ready to continue doing so as the industry continues to evolve.

positions.title: Web Developer/Database Designer
positions.description:
I have been with IBM for eight years, starting with this team while we were still Kenexa and navigating the business transformation that occurred in my first year when Kenexa was acquired by IBM. I lead web development and database design for clients in this role, supporting the creation of HR tools and websites for industry leading companies in retail, transportation, technology, and healthcare.  

Notable Achievements: 
• Spearheaded the sourcing and selection of mapping and geocoding software solutions, selecting OpenStreetMap, LeafletJS, and Gisgraphy to ensure effective integration with existing web applications. 
• Leveraged my GIS expertise to implement mapping and geocoding solutions into applications, such as regional maps with job location markers that provided filtered lists of jobs in those locations. 
• Set up systems used for version control and bug and feature tracking, as well as defined usage guidelines. 
• Integrated web API data sources into complex content management systems and tools to ensure effective presentation of images, HTML carousels, and lightboxes while also supporting content creation and editing by non-technical teams.
• Established policies and processes to support movement of code to staging and production servers, as well as introduced hardening techniques and procedures to improve website security, detection, and response.

positions.title: Analyst Integrator II
positions.description:
During this contract, I assisted the development and improvements for a Renewable Program Management (RPM) website. I enhanced internal and public-facing program sites by assessing functionality and engaging with cross-functional teams to gather requirements. 

Notable Achievements:
• Established a migration plan as the program transitioned to a newly developed application and mitigated related challenges throughout the process.
• Coached junior programmers with programming issues and identified effective problem-solving techniques. 
• Developed test scripts for the QA team to guide the application testing process.

positions.title: Senior Programmer & Database Designer
positions.description:
In this position, I oversaw development, maintenance, troubleshooting, and upgrades to public-facing websites for clients in the marketing and creative design space. 

Notable Achievements:
• Created administrative pages and maximized program search results pages for a government services website, as well as refined a survey tool for the site. 
• Partnered with a restaurant chain on developing and launching a database, enhancing the administrative pages on their website, and improving the .aspx framework for their online menu to enable Facebook likes.

positions.title: Programmer & Database Designer
positions.description:
I collaborated with cross-functional teams across this marketing agency on identifying software development and database design requirements. I was responsible for overseeing the SDLC and ensuring the alignment of technology solutions with our team’s needs.  

Notable Achievement:
• Developed public-facing websites to engage diverse audiences, as well as led the design of an online database that allowed teams to track sales data, build advertising packages, and report client earnings.

positions.title: Senior Programmer
positions.description:
During this tenure, I developed a web-based software package that compiled, categorized, and responded to between 1200 and 50K+ public comments generated through multiple sources on Environmental Impact Statements (EIS). I engaged with project teams, systems planners, and scientists to understand end user requirements, as well as ensured compliance with regulations. I also created and documented map creation procedures for GIS Analysts. 

Notable Achievements:
• Facilitated training for end users to ensure effective integration of the EIS software packages and maximize success across six projects in the land use, power plant, and coal mining sectors. 
• Sourced and selected bug analysis, feature tracking, and version control software, which resulted in enterprise-wide implementation and maintenance of Bugzilla and Subversion solutions. 
• Defined policies for the SDLC and ensured adherence across the development team to drive consistency. 
• Spearheaded the development and implementation of a software used to organize and present chemical analysis results from water and soil samples, organizing data by date, location, and depth of sample.

positions.title: Senior Scientist
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States & Phoenix, Arizona, United States
positions.description: Worked at URS on a contract with the Department of Energy. As Senior Programmer, I was responsible for key software development and database design projects, including onsite for the Yucca Mountain Project. I also created 3D animations to illustrate mountain geology and virtual reality data manipulation tools.
